units.monetary_values: Decimal strings; never binary floats in model accounting.
units.fractions: 0–1 decimal strings; rewardCut and feeShare source scale is 1,000,000
units.usd: Indexed contemporaneous ETH/USD valuation, except explicitly labeled snapshot-price valuations.
units.block_numbers: capture block is Arbitrum L2; round start/end block fields are L1 numbers

definitions.fees: Redeemed winning-ticket face values. Not all jobs, invoices, demand or unredeemed accruals; current settlement currency is ETH.
definitions.mint: LPT Mint events to the protocol Minter, excluding bridge mints. Gross issuance, not net supply change or money earned from fees.
definitions.reward_cut: Operator commission from pool rewards; delegators receive the remainder pro rata, including operator-address stake.
definitions.fee_share: Fraction of current node fee receipts paid to delegators, including operator-address stake.
definitions.own_stake: pendingStake(operator address) at the pinned block, restricted to its own pool; includes accrued rewards/commission. It does not identify total organizational ownership.
definitions.delegations: Positive indexed bond links to active pools; bondedAmount may omit compounding. These are addresses, not identified people or independent organizations.
definitions.latest_completed_round: Matched same-round fees, active stake, cuts and mint ceiling for one-round models. Its fee window differs from the 30 complete UTC days.
definitions.actual_round_rewards: Source rewardTokens=null is normalized to zero with reward_tokens_reported=false; the original value remains embedded.
definitions.explorer_adjustment: Two sender addresses excluded by Explorer chart policy from 2026-08-27. Preserve raw and adjusted values; this exclusion does not establish abuse.
definitions.names: ENS labels captured from an Explorer API without a historical block pin; display labels, not controller verification.

identity_context.documented_role: Livepeer Community Grants / Decentralized Community Node

stake_provenance.meaning: TransferBond and Rebond to the same node; provenance does not establish present common ownership.

identity_context.interpretation: Retained operator receipts are not established personal profit; historical purpose is grants funding.

limitations: This is observed current-system data, not a litepaper deployment, forecast or evidence of self-dealing.
Costs, validator scores, independent demand, quality, internal job value and beneficial wallet ownership are not measured.
Protocol active stake and live pool stake differ because their accounting times differ; do not mix denominators.
Explorer delegator count and indexed positive links are unreconciled; neither is a verified count of people.
Individual delegator pending stakes were not read; never sum indexed bondedAmount as current pool capital.
Existing stake-only issuance must not be labeled fee-linked. MFS, fee burn and validator/treasury shares belong to each model's declared paper version.
Round 4364 crosses the 30-day UTC window end; rounds wholly inside that window are 4331–4363.
Historical redeemed fee receipts do not measure all AI work or off-chain/invoiced activity.
The 30-day receipts include one recipient inactive at capture; fee_recipients preserves it and network totals include its receipts.

provenance.collection: Embedded source responses and exact pinned GraphQL queries. Archive operator calls independently match capture block hash. ENS and spot prices have separate capture times.
